title: feat(web): service map moves under Services in the sidebar

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge Contained sidebar config change; the only edge case is the `/releases` fallback expanding the new sub-list with no current row. 1 note · tests covered · risk low Service Map becomes a sub-row of Services in the sidebar, with a matching collapsed-rail menu and palette titles. Safe to merge; one flag-off edge case renders the new sub-list with no current row. - `servicesItem` gives Services `All services` and `Map` sub-rows, replacing the standalone row - `alsoActive: ["/releases"]` moves onto the spread `servicesItem`, keeping the flag-off fallback ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · Services opens on /releases with neither child row current correctness · [`apps/web/src/shell/nav.ts:140`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/87b6776c264d3b3e744656a6531d98d77ae99c31/apps/web/src/shell/nav.ts#L140) With the releases flag off, `alsoActive` makes `/releases` activate the Services row, and `navRow` then renders its sub-list (`view-nav.ts:147` and `:191`) with neither `All services` nor `Map` matching, so the section expands with nothing highlighted. Every other section with `subItems` has a child at the parent href (`Overview` at `/infra`, `Traces` at `/traces`), so this is the only expanded section that shows no current row. ``` Give `/releases` a child of its own in `servicesItem.subItems` while the flag is off (the way `Containers` hangs off `Hosts`), or render the sub-list only when `activeSubHrefOf(subItems, currentPath)` is defined so a fallback path keeps the parent collapsed. ```
What was checked - `isLinkActive` is segment-aware, so `/service-map` does not mark the `All services` (`/services`) link current (`ui/sidebar.ts:280`) - Palette dedupe by href keeps one entry per page, so `Services`/`Service Map` stay single rows (`palette/entries.ts:84`) - Collapsed rail menu resolves `NavSection` by title, and `Services` is unique among nav titles (`view-menus.ts:225`)
`87b6776` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.
